messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service error-rate spike in eu-west (35%) — responses contain human-readable text instead of numeric vectors. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:
oncall pager: paging linus keller (eu-oncall)
linus keller: oncall here. what's the symptom?
mei wang: logs show embed-handler responding with content_type=chat.text payload. Example log:
```
WARN embed-svc: req=trk-9f2d mismatch: expected=vector payload_type=chat.text first_tokens=\"Hi, how can I help you?\"
stack: handler.go:198
```

rajiv patel: I see a recent change: automated-version-pin job ran 02:42 and pinned alias global-embeds -> redwood/gpt-instruct-v3@canary on dedicated pools. That explains chat model receiving embed traffic.
linus keller: who triggered the pin job? ops-bot?
ops-bot: job automated-version-pin #774 executed by ci/scheduler. Details: target_alias=global-embeds target_model=redwood/gpt-instruct-v3@canary scope=dedicated_pools region=eu-west
mei wang: The kicker: routing config allows alias to be used by both /generate and /embed endpoints depending on model interface; the canary pin didn't validate interface compatibility.
rajiv patel: customers: some batch embed jobs are failing with 400; a few low-latency embed requests returned short text causing application errors.
linus keller: mitigation plan: A) unpin canary from dedicated pools B) set alias to previous model redwood/sem-embed-v2@stable C) patch scheduler to reject pins with interface mismatch. Which is fastest to unblock?
mei wang: A + B together. I'll run commands.
mei wang: running: `redwoodctl pool unpin --region eu-west --selector \"role=embed\" --job automated-version-pin-774`
mei wang: unpin complete. Now setting alias back:
```
redwoodctl routing alias-set --alias global-embeds --model redwood/sem-embed-v2 --version stable --force
```

mei wang: alias reverted. 
linus keller: deploy-bot, confirm no leftover pinned versions on any dedicated pool shards.
deploy-bot: query: `redwoodctl pool list --region eu-west --filter pinned` -> pools: gpu-eu-3 (pinned: none), gpu-eu-7 (pinned: none), gpu-eu-ded-12 (pinned: redwood/gpt-instruct-v3@canary)
rajiv patel: found one straggler pool gpu-eu-ded-12 still pinned. I'm unpinning now.
rajiv patel: `redwoodctl pool unpin --pool-id gpu-eu-ded-12` -> done.
linus keller: cache/state issue: some routing proxies still have KV entries mapping client prefixes to instruct variant. Need to flush edge routing cache for EU.
mei wang: flushing prefix cache for prefix "alias:global-embeds" across eu-west proxies... Command: `redwoodctl cache flush --scope eu-west --prefix alias:global-embeds`
mei wang: cache flush acked.
ops-bot: monitor rule: embedding error-rate back to baseline? Current: 0.9% (was 35%).
linus keller: setting temporary guard: reject-incompatible fallback policy for alias updates touching embed endpoints. Patch applied via runtime flag.
mei wang: added an admission check to scheduler to validate model.interface == alias.expected_interface. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scheduler/pull/498 (WIP).
rajiv patel: customer impact summary for ops: three paying customers saw failed batch jobs between 02:42-02:51 UTC; two automatic retries succeeded after mitigation; one customer should receive a notice. No SLA violations recorded but higher error noise.
pm-olivia: raising customer communications: drafting message now, will wait for timeline confirmation.
linus keller: root cause: automated pin job didn't validate model interface and applied canary across pools used by embed routes. Secondary cause: lack of pool-level pin isolation and stale cache on proxies.
mei wang: remediation tasks: 1) add interface validation to pin job 2) add safety rule to alias updates (interface compatibility) 3) extend canary scope checks so embed aliases are excluded from cross-interface canaries 4) add unit/integration tests in routing CI. Assigned.
linus keller: post-incident ops: sweep dedicated pools, run synthetic embed test suite for eu and us, and add alert to trigger if embed-response-type != vector.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated by linus keller, mei wang, rajiv patel. Actions: [alias_revert, pool_unpin, cache_flush, runtime_guard]. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.
linus keller: handing over to next oncall in 25m. Added notes to the runbook under /oncall/eu/notes/3123460001.
pm-olivia: please include timeline and affected customers list in the postmortem draft.
linus keller: created postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/3123460001-draft. Will assign authorship to mei+rajiv.
mei wang: quick follow: scheduling a config + scheduler review meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC to finalize fixes.
linus keller: thanks all. If any lingering alerts pop, tag this thread. Closing in channel but will update postmortem with RCA and action items. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Slack thread representing an incident where an automated version pin mapped an embeddings alias to a chat/instruct variant causing embed requests to get chat text; includes mitigation commands and post-incident actions.
